content: Hi, I was looking TODOs and found this, and I'm interested and looking for ways to do this, it asks for the higher order Cauchy integral formula at an arbitrary w in Metric.ball c R. My idea is to generalize the existing theorem and keep the Banach valued codomain, the countable exception differntiability assumptions, and then add wrappers parallel to the existing version. Does it look good? Or do we still need this generalization?
